action.sql: SELECT a.actual, b.budget, ROUND(100.0 * a.actual / NULLIF(b.budget, 0), 2) AS pct_used FROM (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit), 0) AS actual FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND account_id = '6500' AND period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06') a, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS budget FROM budgets WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND account_id = '6500' AND period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06') b
